subject: Decision Making
title: Feedback Loops
description: A short lesson to help you apply Feedback Loops.

hook.text: A speed sign that shows your current speed with a smiley or frown reduced speeding by 14%.

buildup.text: Feedback loops close the gap between action and consequence. Most bad habits persist because the damage is invisible.

discovery.text: Smart meters that display real-time electricity usage reduce consumption by 5-15%. Seeing the cost makes it real.

twist.text: Step counters changed exercise behavior worldwide. Fitbit users walk 40% more. A visible number becomes a daily target.

climax.text: The best feedback is immediate, visible, and connected to the behavior.

punchline.text: Show the speed, see the smiley. Instant feedback changes behavior on sight.

quiz.question: Why are real-time feedback loops effective nudges?
options: They make the consequences of actions visible immediately, enabling behavior change
